claims.claim: Very clean ps4 slim special edition with follow come controller and other accessories, it comes with...
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a silver/gray laptop with an “A” logo on the lid; no PS4 is shown, and no controller/accessories are visible.

risks.risk: Item identity mismatch (seller describing PS4 while witness sees a laptop). This can indicate wrong item, bait-and-switch, or scam.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing the exact item being sold: power-on screen with the console model (PS4 Slim Special Edition) and the included controller(s) laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a laptop with unknown specs and unknown working status (worst case: not tested / may have faults), not as a PS4.

risks.risk: Laptop brand/model is not readable; cannot confirm exact configuration that drives value.
risks.proof: One clear photo of the bottom label (model/serial) and BIOS/System Information screen (or sticker) showing CPU/RAM/Storage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest tier for an unverified, unknown-spec laptop condition.

risks.risk: Screen condition and whether it works are unknown (screen not shown).
risks.proof: Clip showing the display turning on with a visible desktop/BIOS screen and brightness at normal level.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: display not confirmed working.

risks.risk: Keyboard/trackpad condition is unknown (only side view; no close-up).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of keyboard and trackpad, plus a quick typing/trackpad movement test on screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: keyboard/trackpad condition unverified.

risks.risk: Battery health/charge status is unknown (no power/usage test shown).
risks.proof: Clip showing battery percentage and whether it charges/holds power (or confirm it runs on battery).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: battery not reliable / not confirmed.

risks.risk: Storage type/capacity and RAM size are unknown (not shown).
risks.proof: Screenshot from system info showing RAM size and storage (SSD/HDD + capacity).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: minimal/unknown storage and RAM.

risks.risk: Charger/adapter inclusion and condition are unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact charger/adapter model and a clip showing it charging the device.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: charger not included or not confirmed.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact item: send a clear photo/video of the PS4 Slim Special Edition (if that’s what you’re selling) with the model visible, or admit it is a laptop and show the laptop clearly.
If it is a laptop: send a photo of the bottom label (brand/model/serial) and a screenshot of System Information (CPU/RAM/Storage).
Show the screen working: short clip with the display on (desktop/BIOS visible).
Show keyboard and trackpad working: quick typing and cursor movement test.
Show battery/charging status (battery percentage and whether it charges/holds).
Show included charger/adapter and its condition (photo + charging clip).
response.reason: The seller describes a PS4 Slim Special Edition, but the witness report shows a laptop with no PS4/controller visible. This identity mismatch is a major red flag, so pricing without proof would be unsafe.
